rows.note: Use 撕 as the all-purpose verb for tearing paper, cloth, and other tearable material apart or off.

example.english: I accidentally rip the sheet of paper.
example.traditional: 我一唔小心就將張紙撕爛咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 zau6 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 si1 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use 衝 as the all-purpose choice when a person, vehicle, or force rushes headlong, including through an area.

example.english: I watch the car rip down the road recklessly.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 hai2 maa5 lou6 soeng6 lyun6 gam3 cung1

rows.note: Use 擷取 specifically for copying audio, video, or other digital data from a disc, stream, or similar source onto a device.

example.english: I rip the livestream onto my hard drive with my computer.
example.traditional: 我用部電腦將段直播擷取落硬碟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 bou6 din6 nou5 zoeng1 dyun6 zik6 bo3 kit3 ceoi2 lok6 ngaang6 dip2
